content:
sapi/phpdbg/phpdbg_parser.y
---we only need cli, not phpdbg. Disable phpdbg---
---reconfigure without phpdbg---
#! /bin/sh
#
# Created by configure

CFLAGS='-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer' \
CXXFLAGS='-O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer' \
LDFLAGS='-fsanitize=address' \
CC='gcc' \
CXX='g++' \
'./configure' \
'--disable-all' \
'--enable-cli' '--disable-phpdbg' \
'--enable-debug' \
'--enable-address-sanitizer' \
"$@"
